title: Los Puesteros, solitary men who look after ranches and livestock in Patagonia
summary: A New Yorker photo essay documenting 'Los Puesteros' - solitary men who tend remote ranches and livestock across the windswept plains of Patagonia at the southern tip of the world, capturing their isolated existence and the stark beauty of the landscape.
problem_solved: Preserves the stories and human experiences of a disappearing way of life in one of Earth's most remote regions.
why_valuable: Offers intimate visual documentation of solitude, resilience, and the fading pastoral culture of Patagonia that few outside the region will ever witness.
